name: io.github.rocket-harbor-420/harbor-cross-chain-report
title: Harbor Crew Cross-Chain Report
description: Opt-in, read-only batch snapshots for 1–5 public EVM addresses across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One, and Polygon. Includes block numbers, EIP-7702 delegation indicators, code sizes, SHA-256 fingerprints, and explorer links. Reports cost 0.02 native USDC on Base, paid directly to the operator; this server never signs or sends payments.
